No defect arises

adjudication.rationale: In Topic#expandable_first_post? the guard `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` was removed (topic.rb change) and there is no replacement check against the new EmbeddableHost-based configuration (e.g., `EmbeddableHost.exists?`). As a result, the method now depends only on `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`, which severs the previous “embedding enabled/hosts configured” coupling. This is a real behavior change, but it’s not provably a defect from the diff alone (it may be intentional to allow expandability for already-embedded topics even if no hosts are configured).
